title: Agent Config
subtitle: Connect Agent tools to Centag proxy: select pipeline, write config and verify
quickSetupHint: Each Agent shows access methods from its capability matrix: write config, UI guide, wrap companion CLI, or built-in. Methods are marked Verified/Unverified — Unverified does not mean unavailable. Wrap also needs system proxy ready before you can copy the command.
groupCliHint: Terminal agents. Most can write local config; companion CLIs can use wrap.
groupDesktopHint: Write local config when supported; otherwise follow the in-app UI guide. Companion CLIs can use wrap (not the .app).
groupTuiHint: In-process terminal agents; no local config files.
groupWebHint: In-process browser automation agents; no local config files.
methodWriteConfigHint: Pick a pipeline in the wizard and write the Agent’s local config (developer-verified).
methodWriteConfigUnverifiedHint: You can connect via the wizard. Unverified only means developers have not personally checked it — not that it is unavailable.
methodUIGuideHint: Fill custom-model fields in the app. After picking a pipeline you can copy the request URL and model ID (developer-verified).
methodUIGuideUnverifiedHint: Fill custom-model fields in the app. Unverified only means developers have not personally checked it — not that it is unavailable.
uiGuidePipelineHint: After you pick a pipeline, the model ID below becomes centag/<pipeline-id>. Copy the values into the client’s custom-model form.
uiGuideParamsTitle: Fill these values in the client
uiGuideParamsHint: Open custom model settings in the client and fill the table below.
uiGuideFillParamsDesc: Copy values and add the model
uiGuideVerifyHint: After adding and selecting the model in the client, send a short chat and confirm it in Centag request logs.
uiGuideVerifyStep1: In the client Settings → Models, add a custom model and paste the request URL and model ID from the previous step.
uiGuideNeedApiKey: Create a Centag API Key first and paste it into the client’s API Key field (it is not written automatically).
uiParamRequestURLHint: Prefer …/v1 (without /chat/completions). If the client errors, try …/v1/chat/completions.
uiParamAPIKeyHint: llmproxy_* key from Profile → API Keys
methodWrapHint: No Agent config changes; traffic is hijacked by system proxy (developer-verified).
methodWrapUnverifiedHint: No Agent config changes needed to try. Unverified only means developers have not personally checked it — not that it is unavailable.
methodWrapDesktopCLIHint: wrap launches the companion CLI (not the desktop .app) via system proxy (developer-verified). Install the CLI first.
methodWrapDesktopCLIUnverifiedHint: wrap launches the companion CLI (not the desktop .app). Unverified does not mean unavailable; install the CLI and ensure system proxy is ready.
wrapDependsOnSystemProxy: Requires the system proxy service to be running (MITM + egress key).
methodBuiltinHint: Built-in Agent — pick a pipeline in the wizard and use it directly.
restartClientHint: After writing config, fully quit and reopen the client so the new settings take effect.
wrapHint: Unlike write-config: wrap uses system-proxy hijack (no Agent config edits); shown here for easy verification.
wrapStatusUnknown: Could not load system proxy status. Open System Proxy and confirm MITM is on and an egress key is configured.
wrapNeedMitm: System proxy is off (MITM not running). Enable it under System Proxy before using wrap.
wrapNeedEgress: Egress API key is not configured. Finish egress key setup under System Proxy before using wrap.
wrapNeedMitmAndEgress: System proxy is not ready: start MITM and configure an egress API key under System Proxy.
builtinProviderRoute: Built-in provider route config (system preset, not editable)
selectPipelineHint: Just select a pipeline. Backend and model are determined by pipeline internal nodes; no separate configuration needed here.
apiKeyAutoWrite: During setup, decryptable llmproxy_* keys under your account will be automatically written to the Agent config.
apiKeyCreateFirst: Please create an API Key in your profile first; otherwise config cannot be generated or written.
apiKeyDetected: Available API Key detected; it will be auto-filled when generating config (the full key is never shown in the UI).
noPipeline: No available pipelines. Please add in 'Policy Management' first
writeConfigHint: Write Centag proxy address and current account API Key to {agent}.
writeConfigKeySource: Keys come from decryptable llmproxy_* keys in Profile → API Keys (server-injected; preview is sanitized).
configPreviewHint: After confirming, click above to write config. Team edition can also copy the command below to write manually.
configGenFailed: Config generation failed, please go back and retry
verifyHint: Please verify whether {agent} is using Centag proxy as follows
verifySuccessHint: After verification, this Agent's requests will go through Centag and be routed to the backend & model configured in the selected pipeline.
verifyCommandHint: Run the following command in terminal to confirm connectivity with Centag and a model response (requires the Agent CLI installed locally):
verifyChecklistStep1: Restart or reopen {agent} to ensure the latest config is loaded.
verifyChecklistStep2: Send a simple chat or completion request (e.g. ask about the current model).
verifyChecklistStep3: In Centag Request Log / Dashboard, confirm the request appears with pipeline {pipeline}.
verifyChecklistStep4: If it fails: check API Key validity, whether Centag service is running, and whether the Agent's Base URL points to local Centag.
restoreConfirm: This will restore {name}'s local config to the state before connecting to Centag. If a backup exists before writing, it will be restored; if the config was newly created by Centag, the corresponding file will be deleted.
noApiKeyForAgent: No available Centag API Key for agent access
noApiKeyHint: No available Centag API Key (llmproxy_*) under current account. Please create one in your profile first.
copyFailed: Copy failed, please select and copy manually

claude-code.description: Anthropic's official AI coding assistant CLI
claude-code.configMethod: Writes ~/.claude/settings.json by merging env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_MODEL to point at Centag. First overwrite creates a .centag-bak backup.
claude-code.installHint: macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh {'|'} bash; or brew install --cask claude-code

claude-desktop.configMethod: On macOS/Windows: set deploymentMode=3p on Claude + Claude-3p, and write a Centag gateway profile in configLibrary (inferenceGatewayBaseUrl / ApiKey / AuthScheme=bearer / inferenceProvider=gateway). Restart Desktop to apply.
claude-desktop.configMethodUnsupported: Local write for Claude Desktop is not supported on this platform (macOS/Windows only). Use one-click setup on a supported system.
claude-desktop.installHint: Download the Claude Desktop app from the official site (not a CLI)

codex.description: OpenAI's official AI coding assistant CLI (ChatGPT Codex)
codex.installHint: curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh {'|'} sh; or npm i -g {'@'}openai/codex

gemini-cli.description: Google's official AI coding assistant CLI
gemini-cli.configMethod: Writes ~/.gemini/.env (GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL / GEMINI_MODEL) and merges settings.json security.auth.selectedType=gemini-api-key.
gemini-cli.installHint: npm i -g {'@'}google/gemini-cli; or brew install gemini-cli

grok-build.configMethod: Overwrites ~/.grok/config.toml with [models] default="centag" and [model."centag"] fields (model / base_url / api_key / api_backend=responses).
grok-build.installHint: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh {'|'} bash; or npm i -g {'@'}xai-official/grok

opencode.configMethod: Merges into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json: upsert provider.centag and set default model. Other providers are preserved.
opencode.installHint: curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install {'|'} bash; or npm i -g opencode-ai

openclaw.configMethod: Merges into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json: upsert models.providers.centag and set agents.defaults.model.primary.

pi.description: AI agent toolkit / coding agent CLI (pi.dev)
pi.configMethod: Merges into ~/.pi/agent/models.json: upsert providers.centag (api=openai-completions), and set settings.json defaultProvider/defaultModel.
pi.installHint: curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh {'|'} sh; or npm i -g --ignore-scripts {'@'}earendil-works/pi-coding-agent

hermes.configMethod: Merges into ~/.hermes/config.yaml: update model defaults and upsert custom_providers entry name=centag.

codebuddy.description: Tencent CodeBuddy desktop; companion CodeBuddy Code CLI (codebuddy) shares models.json
codebuddy.configMethod: Merges into ~/.codebuddy/models.json. url must be a full …/v1/chat/completions path; shared by desktop and CLI.
codebuddy.installHint: Desktop: download from site. CLI (for wrap): npm i -g {'@'}tencent-ai/codebuddy-code; or brew install codebuddy-code

workbuddy.description: Tencent WorkBuddy desktop assistant (fill custom model fields in Settings)
workbuddy.configMethod: In WorkBuddy Settings → Models, add a custom API: prefer …/v1 (…/v1/chat/completions also works); model ID centag/<pipeline>.
workbuddy.installHint: Download the desktop app from the CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy site

trae.description: ByteDance TRAE IDE (custom OpenAI-compatible models; add inside the IDE)
trae.configMethod: TRAE: Settings → Models → Add → Custom. OpenAI format; turn Full URL OFF; request URL = …/v1; model ID = centag/<pipeline>.
trae.installHint: Download from trae.ai / trae.cn; custom models must be added under Settings → Models

coding-tui.configMethod: TUI agents do not write local config files; routing is bound in-process via pipelines.
coding-tui.installHint: Built-in capability; no separate CLI install

education-tui.configMethod: TUI agents do not write local config files; routing is bound in-process via pipelines.
education-tui.installHint: Built-in capability; no separate CLI install

coding-web.installHint: Built-in capability; no separate CLI install
